prompt:
Design a tabbed open tray to be cut from 6 mm sheet on the CNC router. It needs three parts: `base`, `walls` and `flat_layout`.

The stock thickness, the kerf clearance and the tray's interface dimensions are already in the project's `globals.py` - read them through `hc` rather than repeating the numbers.

Geometry, all in millimetres:

- `base` is the base panel: a 110 x 90 blank, one sheet thick, centred on the origin and lying under the tray with its top face on z = 0 (so it spans z = -6 to 0). It carries eight through slots, two for each wall (below).
- `walls` is the four assembled walls. They stand on the base's top face and rise 40 mm (z = 0 to 40). Each wall is one sheet thick. The two long walls run the full 100 mm along X with their outer faces at y = -40 and y = +40. The two short walls run along Y between the long walls' inner faces (68 mm long) with their outer faces at x = -50 and x = +50.
- Every wall carries two tabs on its bottom edge: one sheet thick, 12 mm long, hanging one sheet thickness below the wall (z = -6 to 0), centred a quarter of that wall's length in from each end - so the long walls' tabs sit at x = -25 and x = +25, and the short walls' tabs at y = -17 and y = +17.
- The base's eight slots are the tab footprints grown by the kerf on every side: each slot is (tab length + kerf) by (sheet thickness + kerf), cut all the way through, centred on its tab. The tabs must pass through without touching the slot walls, while the walls' bottom edges rest on the base.
- `flat_layout` is the cut file: the same five panels laid out flat on the sheet, all of them spanning z = 0 to 6 and none of them overlapping. This is the part the shop cuts, so its as-built DXF must show exactly five outer profiles (the base panel's slots are interior cut-outs of its profile).

Build all three parts and export `flat_layout` as DXF when the geometry is right.
notes: Difficulty 2. Checks: assembled zero interference + seating contact, both envelopes, wall/base material budgets (the base's pins the kerf), base genus 8, layout one sheet thick with the same total material. Export: as_built DXF of the cut layout with profile_count = 5. The 2026-07-26 corpus audit widened the three volume windows from +/-30/15/40 to +/-50/50/100, each ~3x below the smallest error it must reject (a missing tab, 432 mm^3; a kerfless slot set, 175; a layout short of a panel, tens of thousands). Budget unchanged at 32.
